name: Seven Autonomous Product Engineering Stack
rule: A configured name is not proof. Every feature reports ACTIVE_GUARDED, ACTIVE_RECORDING, CONFIGURED, SCAFFOLDED, or UNPROVEN according to executable evidence.

systems.purpose: Shared domain-routed engineering/product encyclopedia and visual reference corpus.
Independent product-quality verdict separate from build PASS.
Bounded final-gate and APK repair with rollback.
Exact-source Android installed-artifact capture and journey evidence via dedicated workflow.
systems.activationProof: successful Seven Reality Lab run bound to candidate SHA/APK SHA256

systems.purpose: Champion/challenger registry for isolated agent candidates; promotion blocked without comparative proof.
Repository dependency graph, subsystem inventory, hotspots and blast-radius evidence.
Executable project invariants and proof-level policy; runtime invariant coverage grows over time.
Capability dimensions, strike-team policy, calibration history and shadow-role evolution without autonomous privilege escalation.
Stable persona population for repeatable product journeys.
Technical/product/evidence/proof debt taxonomy with blocking severities.
Experiment lineage records observations and hypotheses; causal claims require controlled evidence.
Privacy-aware latency, reliability and GenAI operation metrics schema.
Evidence-weighted trust decision; any hard invariant failure blocks promotion.
